# Backend Documentation

This project is a Next.js 14 (App Router) application called **Solo Shop Builder**, a private e-commerce platform for micro-sellers. The stack consists of TypeScript, Next.js API route handlers, Prisma ORM backed by PostgreSQL, iron-session for encrypted cookie-based authentication, Stripe and MyFatoorah for payment processing, Nodemailer (SMTP) for transactional email, and AWS S3 (with local filesystem fallback) for file storage. Rate limiting is applied in-process. All monetary values are stored and transmitted in cents (integer).

---

## API Endpoints

### Authentication

| Method | Path | Description | Auth Required | Key Request Fields | Key Response Fields |
|--------|------|-------------|---------------|--------------------|---------------------|
| `POST` | `/api/auth/signup` | Create seller account or find existing one; sends a 32-character magic-link token to email (valid 15 min). Optionally sets a password. Rate limited. | No | `email`, `password?` | `message` |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/verify` | Verifies magic-link token (AJAX); creates session cookie. | No | `token` | `success`, `hasShop` |
| `GET` | `/api/auth/verify` | Verifies magic-link token (direct link click); redirects to `/dashboard` or `/dashboard/create-shop`. | No | `?token=` (query) | Redirect |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/login` | Password-based login; creates session cookie. Rate limited. | No | `email`, `password` | `message`, `seller.id`, `seller.email` |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/logout` | Destroys the current session cookie. | No | — | `message` |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/forgot-password` | Generates a password-reset token (valid 1 hour) and emails a reset link. Rate limited. | No | `email` | `message` |
| `POST` | `/api/auth/reset-password` | Validates reset token and sets a new password; clears the reset token. | No | `token`, `newPassword` | `message` |

### Account

| Method | Path | Description | Auth Required | Key Request Fields | Key Response Fields |
|--------|------|-------------|---------------|--------------------|---------------------|
| `POST` | `/api/account/password` | Change or set seller password. Requires current password if one is already set. | Yes | `currentPassword?`, `newPassword` | `message` |
| `POST` | `/api/account/delete` | GDPR account deletion: removes all order items, orders, product variants, products, shops, auth tokens, and the seller record, then destroys session. | Yes | — | `message` |

### Shops

| Method | Path | Description | Auth Required | Key Request Fields | Key Response Fields |
|--------|------|-------------|---------------|--------------------|---------------------|
| `GET` | `/api/shops` | List all shops belonging to the authenticated seller. | Yes | — | Array of shop objects |
| `POST` | `/api/shops` | Create a new shop. Seller may only have one shop. Slug must be unique, lowercase alphanumeric + hyphens (3–30 chars). Rate limited. | Yes | `name`, `slug`, `currency?` (`USD`\|`KWD`) | Shop object |
| `GET` | `/api/shops/[slug]/currency` | Get a shop's currency setting. | No | — | `currency` |
| `PUT` | `/api/shops/[slug]/currency` | Update a shop's currency. Must be owner. | Yes | `currency` (`USD`\|`KWD`) | `currency` |
| `PUT` | `/api/shops/status` | Toggle the authenticated seller's shop status to `ACTIVE` or `PAUSED`. | Yes | `status` | `shop.id`, `shop.status`, `message` |
| `GET` | `/api/shops/profile` | Fetch seller's shop profile fields. | Yes | — | `shop` (id, name, slug, displayName, publicDescription, description, instagramUrl, facebookUrl, twitterUrl) |
| `PATCH` | `/api/shops/profile` | Update shop profile (displayName max 100 chars, publicDescription max 500 chars, social URLs validated). | Yes | `displayName?`, `publicDescription?`, `description?`, `instagramUrl?`, `facebookUrl?`, `twitterUrl?` | `message`, `shop` |
| `GET` | `/api/shops/email-template` | Fetch the shop's custom order confirmation email template body. | Yes | — | `shop.id`, `shop.emailTemplateBody` |
| `PATCH` | `/api/shops/email-template` | Update the shop's custom order confirmation email template body (max 10 KB). | Yes | `emailTemplateBody` | `message`, `shop.id`, `shop.emailTemplateBody` |
| `PATCH` | `/api/shops/branding` | Update shop branding: colors, tagline, logo URL, or logo file upload (PNG/JPEG, max 2 MB). Uploads to S3 or local filesystem. | Yes | `primaryColor?`, `accentColor?`, `logoUrl?`, `tagline?`, `logo?` (file) | `message`, `shop` (id, primaryColor, accentColor, logoUrl, logoImageUrl, tagline), `logoImageUrl` |

### Products

| Method | Path | Description | Auth Required | Key Request Fields | Key Response Fields |
|--------|------|-------------|---------------|--------------------|---------------------|
| `GET` | `/api/products` | List all products for a given shop. | No | `?shopId=` (query, required) | Array of product objects |
| `POST` | `/api/products` | Create a new product in the authenticated seller's shop. Rate limited. | Yes | `title`, `description?`, `price` (cents), `imageUrl?`, `category?`, `stock?` | Product object |
| `GET` | `/api/products/[id]` | Fetch a single product by ID (includes shop name and slug). | No | — | Product object |
| `PATCH` | `/api/products/[id]` | Update product fields. Seller must own the product's shop. | Yes | `title`, `description?`, `price`, `imageUrl?`, `category?`, `stock?` | Product object |
| `DELETE` | `/api/products/[id]` | Delete a product. Seller must own the product's shop. | Yes | — | `success` |
| `PUT` | `/api/products/[id]/status` | Set product status to `PUBLISHED` or `DRAFT`. | Yes | `status` | `message`, `product.id`, `product.title`, `product.status` |
| `GET` | `/api/products/[id]/images` | List all images for a product ordered by `displayOrder`. | No | — | `images` array |
| `POST` | `/api/products/[id]/images` | Add an image to a product. Auto-increments `displayOrder` if not specified. | Yes | `imageUrl` (URL), `displayOrder?` | `image` |
| `DELETE` | `/api/products/[id]/images` | Delete a specific image by `imageId`. | Yes | `?imageId=` (query) | `success`, `deletedImage` |
| `GET` | `/api/products/[id]/variants` | List all variants for a product ordered by creation date. | No | — | `variants` array |
| `POST` | `/api/products/[id]/variants` | Create a new variant for a product. | No (no auth check in handler) | `name`, `value`, `price?`, `stock?`, `sku?` | `variant` |
| `PATCH` | `/api/products/[id]/variants/[variantId]` | Update a variant's fields. | No (no auth check in handler) | `name?`, `value?`, `price?`, `stock?`, `sku?` | `variant` |
| `DELETE` | `/api/products/[id]/variants/[variantId]` | Delete a variant. | No (no auth check in handler) | — | `message` |
| `POST` | `/api/products/bulk-status` | Update `status` for multiple products at once. All products must belong to the authenticated seller. | Yes | `productIds` (array), `status` (`PUBLISHED`\|`DRAFT`) | `message`, `count` |
| `POST` | `/api/products/upload` | Upload a product image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF; max 5 MB). Uploads to S3 if configured, otherwise local filesystem. | No (no auth check in handler) | `file` (multipart) | `success`, `url`, `filename` |
| `GET` | `/api/products/export` | Export all seller's products as a CSV file download. | Yes | — | CSV file (`Content-Disposition: attachment`) |
| `POST` | `/api/products/import` | Import products from a CSV upload (max 10 MB). Valid categories: Handmade, Vintage, Supplies, Other. Prices in dollars (converted to cents). Invalid rows are skipped and reported. | Yes | `file` (multipart CSV) | `success`, `imported`, `errors`, `errorDetails` |

### Orders

| Method | Path | Description | Auth Required | Key Request Fields | Key Response Fields |
|--------|------|-------------|---------------|--------------------|---------------------|
| `GET` | `/api/orders` | If `?paymentId=` query param supplied, returns matching order (public, for receipt display). Otherwise returns all orders for the authenticated seller's shops. | Conditional | `?paymentId=` (optional query) | `orders` array |
| `GET` | `/api/orders/[id]` | Public order tracking. Returns order with items and shop name/slug. | No | — | `order` |
| `PATCH` | `/api/orders/[id]` | Update order `status`, `trackingId`, or `trackingUrl`. Logs status change to `OrderHistory`. Seller must own order's shop. Valid statuses: `pending`, `paid`, `in_progress`, `shipped`, `delivered`, `canceled`. | Yes | `status?`, `trackingId?`, `trackingUrl?` | `order` |
| `GET` | `/api/orders/[id]/history` | Fetch status-change history for an order in descending date order. | Yes | — | `history` array |
| `POST` | `/api/orders/[id]/refund` | Issue a Stripe refund for a paid/in-progress/shipped/delivered order. Sends refund notification email to customer. | Yes | — | `message`, `order`, `refund.id`, `refund.amount`, `refund.status` |
| `GET` | `/api/orders/export` | Export all orders for the seller's shop as a CSV file download. | Yes | — | CSV file (`Content-Disposition: attachment`) |

### Checkout

| Method | Path | Description | Auth Required | Key Request Fields | Key Response Fields |
|--------|------|-------------|---------------|--------------------|---------------------|
| `POST` | `/api/checkout` | Create a Stripe Checkout session. Validates products, prices, and stock. Stores `cartItems` in Stripe metadata for webhook stock decrement. Shop must be `ACTIVE`. | No | `items` (array of `{productId, variantId?, price, quantity}`), `shopSlug`, `customerEmail?` | `sessionId`, `url` |
| `POST` | `/api/checkout/myfatoorah` | Create a MyFatoorah payment session. Creates a pending order in DB first. Returns redirect URL for hosted payment page. | No | `shopSlug`, `items` (array of `{productId, quantity}`), `customerEmail?`, `paymentMethod?` | `paymentUrl`, `invoiceId`, `paymentId`, `orderId` |
| `GET` | `/api/checkout/myfatoorah/callback` | Handle redirect from MyFatoorah after payment. Verifies payment status via MyFatoorah API, updates order to `paid`, sends confirmation email, redirects to success page. | No | `?paymentId=` (query) | Redirect |
| `POST` | `/api/checkout/myfatoorah/callback` | MyFatoorah webhook notification endpoint. Verifies HMAC-SHA256 signature before processing. | No | Raw webhook body with `X-MyFatoorah-Signature` header | — |

### Webhooks

| Method | Path | Description | Auth Required | Key Request Fields | Key Response Fields |
|--------|------|-------------|---------------|--------------------|---------------------|
| `POST` | `/api/webhooks/stripe` | Stripe webhook handler. Verifies `stripe-signature` HMAC header. Handles `checkout.session.completed`: validates stock atomically in a DB transaction, creates order + order items, decrements stock, sends order confirmation email to customer and notification email to seller. Logs all events to `Webhook` audit table. | No (HMAC verified) | Raw Stripe event body | `{ received: true }` |

### Analytics & Billing

| Method | Path | Description | Auth Required | Key Request Fields | Key Response Fields |
|--------|------|-------------|---------------|--------------------|---------------------|
| `GET` | `/api/analytics` | Returns analytics for the last 30 days: total revenue, order count, product count, top 5 products by quantity sold, daily revenue breakdown. Only counts orders with status `paid`, `in_progress`, `shipped`, or `delivered`. | Yes | — | `analytics.totalRevenue`, `analytics.orderCount`, `analytics.productCount`, `analytics.topProducts`, `analytics.dailyRevenue`, `analytics.periodDays` |
| `GET` | `/api/billing` | Returns billing dashboard: total revenue, total orders, average order value, estimated Stripe fees (2.9% + $0.30 per paid order), net revenue, and a transactions list for all `paid` orders. | Yes | — | `totalRevenue`, `totalOrders`, `averageOrderValue`, `stripeFees`, `netRevenue`, `currency`, `transactions` |

## Data Model

### Seller
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `id` | `String` (UUID) | Primary key |
| `email` | `String` | Unique |
| `passwordHash` | `String?` | bcrypt hash (12 rounds); null if magic-link only |
| `passwordResetToken` | `String?` | Unique; nanoid(32) |
| `passwordResetExpires` | `DateTime?` | Expires 1 hour after generation |
| `createdAt` | `DateTime` | |
| `updatedAt` | `DateTime` | |

**Relations:** has many `Shop`, has many `AuthToken`

### Shop
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `id` | `String` (UUID) | Primary key |
| `name` | `String` | |
| `slug` | `String` | Unique; URL-safe identifier |
| `sellerId` | `String` | FK → Seller |
| `displayName` | `String?` | Max 100 chars |
| `publicDescription` | `String?` | Max 500 chars (enforced in app layer) |
| `description` | `String?` | Legacy field |
| `instagramUrl` | `String?` | |
| `facebookUrl` | `String?` | |
| `twitterUrl` | `String?` | |
| `primaryColor` | `String?` | Default `#3B4C63` |
| `accentColor` | `String?` | Default `#10B981` |
| `logoUrl` | `String?` | External URL |
| `logoImageUrl` | `String?` | Uploaded file path (S3 or local) |
| `tagline` | `String?` | Max 100 chars |
| `emailTemplateBody` | `String?` |
